newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian forex market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian forex market closed for holiday.

text.p: The foreign exchange market is closed on Wednesday for the Wesak Day holiday.
On Tuesday, the ringgit fell back against the dollar on strong bids for the dollar/ringgit by European players, dealers said.
But stop-loss selling capped the dollar's rise at 2.5020/30, they said.
The ringgit was quoted at 2.5000/10 a dollar at 1000 GMT on Tuesday against 2.4990/5000 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Monday. It traded as high as 2.4940/50 earlier. .
